download_finalization.reason: The earlier author-version transfer overlapped the later proceedings transfer to the same path, leaving an earlier-response remainder after the completed proceedings response.
download_finalization.checks: The response's linearized PDF header declares /L 1468508 and its EOF ends at exactly byte 1468508. Only bytes after that boundary were discarded; no byte within the proceedings response was rewritten. Final pdfinfo and pdftotext completed without diagnostics.

source_warnings: The requested OpenReview forum presents browser verification; its PDF and public metadata API returned HTTP 403. Title and venue were instead verified against the official ICLR proceedings page.
A pinned arXiv v4 fallback candidate was fetched before the proceedings location was found. It is a later author revision, not a verified proceedings copy, and is not used in the saved source.

An overlapping-download trailing remainder was removed using the documented response-length recipe; the final PDF is the complete official proceedings response, not a reconstructed manuscript. No fourth download was attempted.

Appendices A-E are excluded by the main-body scope. In particular, Appendix B's RCPS/LTT comparisons and Appendix D's additional covariate-shift experiment are not in the permitted input; they remain accessible in the saved complete PDF. No subset of main-body tasks or findings was selected.
extraction_warnings: Raw extraction contains compressed words, reordered mathematical tokens, control characters, and font-encoding artifacts. No OCR, normalization, equation repair, or source rewriting was performed.
Figures 1-4 are preserved through all extractable labels and captions; the illustrations and plotted curves remain in the PDF. No main-body tables were found.

The original algorithm definition, Equation (4), is in Section 1.1 inside Introduction and is excluded under the requested rule; its criterion also appears in the retained Theorem 1 proof. Later cross-references remain unchanged.
The main-body non-monotone failure case, its conservatism caveat, and the unresolved CVaR statement are all retained.
Incidental page headers, page numbers, and form feeds inside selected slices are unchanged. The limitations-only final slice ends with the original space preceding the excluded summary sentence.
